name: Mauritius
summary: Four equal horizontal stripes of red, blue, yellow and green. Adopted at independence from Britain on 12 March 1968, it has no emblem.
origin: The flag was designed for independence, combining colours associated with the country's political parties and its landscape. It was first raised on 12 March 1968.

colors.name: Red
colors.meaning: The struggle for freedom and independence.

colors.name: Blue
colors.meaning: The Indian Ocean surrounding the island.

colors.name: Yellow
colors.meaning: The new light of independence shining over the island.

colors.name: Green
colors.meaning: The agriculture of Mauritius, and its colour throughout the year.

facts: It is one of the few national flags with four equal horizontal stripes.
Mauritius was the only known home of the dodo, which appears on its coat of arms.
Its stripes are often compared to a rainbow.
clues: Four equal stripes of red, blue, yellow and green.
Its island country was the home of the dodo.
Its blue stands for the surrounding Indian Ocean.
